versions.content: The function Fr_GetGlobalTime shall ensure that the time information is consistent and valid. This means that the values returned of both parameters (Fr_CyclePtr and Fr_MacrotickPtr) must be taken from a single point in time. The resulting global time shall always strictly increase over time (until it wraps around at the time-boundary).
